final: {"prompt":"Create a square, full-bleed nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use a deep midnight blue and charcoal ground, cut through by restless strokes of vermilion, bright coral, electric teal, and pale gold. Layer dense, dry-brushed bands with translucent washes, scraped pigment, soft blooms, and fine splatters. Let the marks gather into a turbulent knot just off center, then loosen into long, uneven gestures that pull toward the edges. Set sharp, high-contrast strokes against broad areas of quiet, nearly empty dark color; make the composition feel alert, searching, and unresolved through shifting rhythm and spatial tension. Emphasize tactile paint texture, varied stroke weight, and visible layering. Keep every form purely abstract: no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Fill the entire square image with the painting; no frame, border, wall, room, or gallery setting."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
